title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Claim Reporting Periods and Documentation Thresholds
content:
For each coverage level of the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan, this schedule fixes the reporting periods that run from the discovery of a loss or from the filing of a claim, and the claimed amounts above which further documentation is required. All periods are in calendar days.

## Reporting periods (calendar days)

| Coverage level | Police report (days after discovery) | Notice to facility office (days after discovery) | Claim filing (days after discovery) | Itemized proof of loss (days after filing) | Answer to a document request (days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 3 | 2 | 60 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 3 | 2 | 60 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 3 | 2 | 60 | 30 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 3 | 2 | 90 | 45 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 3 | 2 | 90 | 45 | 30 |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 3 | 2 | 90 | 45 | 30 |

## Documentation thresholds

| Coverage level | Itemized inventory with proof of ownership required above (USD) | Adjuster inspection required above (USD) | Photographs required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $2,000 Plan | 500.00 | 1500.00 | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $3,000 Plan | 500.00 | 2000.00 | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $5,000 Plan | 750.00 | 3000.00 | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $7,500 Plan | 1000.00 | 4000.00 | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $10,000 Plan | 1000.00 | 5000.00 | Yes |
| Bluegate Tenant Protection $15,000 Plan | 1500.00 | 7500.00 | Yes |

Photographs of the damage or of the forced entry are required at every level.

## Filing channels

At every level a claim is filed through the care center by phone or through the online portal. The facility office is not a claim filing channel.

## Points of reading

- The police-report, facility-notice and claim-filing periods run from the **discovery date**; the proof-of-loss period runs from the **filing date**.
- The claim filing period is 60 days on the $2,000, $3,000 and $5,000 Plans and 90 days on the $7,500, $10,000 and $15,000 Plans; the proof-of-loss period is 30 and 45 days on the same two groups.
- A threshold applies to a claimed amount **above** the figure. On the $2,000 Plan, for example, a hypothetical claimed amount of exactly 500.00 does not pass the inventory threshold of 500.00, while 500.01 does; a claimed amount of 1,600.00 also passes the adjuster-inspection threshold of 1500.00.
